slides.title: Every yes *spends an hour you don't have.
slides.body: The to-do list only grows. Something has to come off.

slides.title: Name *3 things you stop doing.
slides.body: Calls with no agenda. Tasks someone else owns. Work you redo out of habit.

slides.title: Put it *next to the to-do list.
slides.body: Same page. Read both before you plan the day.

slides.title: Before you say yes, *read the list.
slides.body: If the ask is on it, the answer is already made.

slides.title: Decide *once.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
